**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must treat this as an urgent, preventable threat—not a distant thought experiment.

2. We believe plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. The stakes demand action now, before this technology is built.

3. A catastrophe killing at least a billion people is what we face if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years. We cannot accept that future as inevitable. We must act to prevent it.

**(b) Newsletter opening (104 words)**

We are facing a choice with stakes unlike any other. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. This is not a distant possibility we can afford to ignore; it is a future we must prevent. The decisions made now—by governments, technology companies, researchers, and the public—will shape whether this technology is built and how much risk we impose on everyone. We are calling for urgent action to stop the race toward superintelligent AI and to put human safety first. The cost of delay is measured in lives, and the time to act is now.
